question.worked_solution:
To plot the given curve, we follow these steps:

- Start with the graph of $y=\operatorname{cos}⁡x.$

- Then, stretch it parallel to the $y$-axis by a stretch factor of $\frac{3}{2}.$

The resulting graph is shown below.

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/linear/14255908/assets/972c49f96a0787507a40567bc9a1c8ad3ceecd33e54711e1a52681865a259d6f.png)

From the graph, we see that the maximum value is ${y}_{max}=1.5$ and the minimum value is ${y}_{min}=-1.5.$ Therefore, the amplitude is

$$
\begin{aligned}\text{Amplitude } & =\frac{{y}_{max}-{y}_{min}}{2} \\  & =\frac{1.5-(-1.5)}{2} \\  & =\frac{1.5+1.5}{2} \\  & =\frac{3}{2}.\end{aligned}
$$
